content.title: Bosch Rexroth M6x25-4.6 Hex Bolt, M6x1mm, 25mm Length, Carbon Steel, Property Class 4.6, ISO 898-1
content.short_description: Bosch Rexroth M6x25-4.6 hex bolt, carbon steel, property class 4.6, thread size M6x1mm, 25mm length, per ISO 898-1.
content.long_description:
The Bosch Rexroth M6x25-4.6 is a hex head bolt manufactured from carbon steel with a hex drive for wrench or socket installation. Thread size is M6 with a 1mm pitch, and the bolt length measures 25mm from under the head to the tip.

This fastener is rated to property class 4.6 under ISO 898-1, corresponding to a tensile strength of 400 MPa. Property class 4.6 designates a minimum yield strength at 60% of the tensile rating, suitable for general-purpose fastening applications not subject to high load or shock conditions.

Use this bolt for standard M6 threaded connections where a carbon steel hex bolt meeting ISO 898-1 mechanical property requirements is specified. Confirm mating nut or tapped hole thread pitch (1mm) and verify grip length against joint thickness before installation.
